(12) (Bind to the cycle) End of Summary Chapter on Terms (Paññatti Uddesavāro) I. Exposition Chapter on Terms (Paṇ n. attivāra Uddesa) 1. Chapter on Puriﬁcation of Words (Padasodhanavāra) Positive (Anuloma) 10. It is eye. Is it eye base? Divine eye and Wisdom eye are eye, but not eye base. Eye base is both eye and eye base. It is eye base. Is it eye? Yes. It is ear. Is it ear base? Divine ear and stream of craving are ear, but not ear base. Ear base is both ear and ear base. It is ear base. Is it ear? Yes. It is nose. Is it nose base? Yes. It is nose base. Is it nose? Yes.
